svg.title: Sidira sticker · aperture hex (ink on paper)
svg.desc: Hexagonal die-cut sticker, 38 mm point-to-point. Paper ground (#F4EFE6), monochrome ink mark (#0E1A2B). Hexagon orientation matches the mark's inner aperture: points face top and bottom, flat edges face left and right. Mark holds the §1.4 clear space (one blade-length) inside the die. The hexagon outline is the DIE-LINE: non-printing, cut path only.
